jobs.description:
Job Description

Job DescriptionOverview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.


Job Description

As a Security Officer Access Control Compliance in Lewisville, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Financial Institutions, and more. Join Allied Universal as an Access Control Officer supporting a financial institution location. You will manage entry points, verify credentials, issue and monitor badges, conduct routine patrols, and help to deter security-related incidents through a visible presence. Deliver exceptional customer service and clear communication while working with a team that is agile, reliable, innovative, caring, and committed to integrity.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $25.00 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTimeMon02:00 PM - 10:00 PMTue02:00 PM - 10:00 PMSat10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSun02:00 PM - 10:00 PM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to clients, visitors, and employees at a financial institution by carrying out access-control procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Monitor entry and exit points, verify authorization credentials, and manage visitor access in accordance with established procedures.
  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, promptly communicating observations to appropriate personnel.
  • Maintain accurate access-related logs, visitor records, and incident documentation as required by site procedures.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of access points, lobby areas, and the business perimeter to help to deter unauthorized activity.

Minimum Requirements:

  • At least 2 years of Security Experience is required.
  • Access Control/Badge Experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

jobs.title: Silver Shield is hiring: Security Officer in Lewisville
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
Salary: $15-$18
Silver Shield Inc. currently seeking a dedicated and experienced Security Officer to join our team.
The Security Officer will be responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for our clients, employees, and visitors.
This position requires strong surveillance skills, conflict management abilities, and knowledge of law enforcement procedures.
Shifts Available:
Evening overnight and weekend shifts available
Duties:
* Patrol assigned areas on foot or in a vehicle to ensure the safety and security of the premises.
* Monitor surveillance cameras and alarm systems to detect any suspicious activity.
* Respond to alarms and investigate disturbances.
* Provide assistance and guidance to employees and visitors in emergency situations.
* Enforce company policies and procedures to maintain order and prevent unauthorized access.
* Conduct regular inspections to identify potential security risks or hazards.
* Write detailed incident reports and maintain accurate records of daily activities.
* Collaborate with local law enforcement agencies when necessary.
Skills:
* Strong surveillance skills to effectively monitor premises using CCTV systems.
* Excellent conflict management abilities to handle difficult situations calmly and professionally.
* Knowledge of law enforcement procedures, including arrest techniques and legal rights.
* CPR certification and first aid training to provide immediate medical assistance if needed.
* Familiarity with loss prevention strategies to prevent theft or damage to property.
Requirements:
* High school diploma or equivalent
* Proven work experience as a Security Officer or in a similar role preferred
* Must possess a valid driver's license
* Ability to pass a background check and drug screening
We will help you get your Level II certification within the first 30 days if you dont already have it.
